notes.title: Some general news
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250998/50c7f6ff1e900f41debcebf2d3103a40c4149ac5.png[/img]

Hello there! 

We have some exciting news about [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2228340/Burning_Secrets__A_Bara_Visual_Novel/]Burning Secrets[/url]! As some of you may already know, it belongs to the same universe as [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1704310/Burning_Horns_A_Bara_Isekai_JRPG/]Burning Horns[/url].

Our team has been working hard to fine-tune the game and make sure you have a great experience. We've received some feedback about errors in the writing in the last builds, so we've hired a reviewer to fix them and make necessary improvements. 
Thanks to the valuable feedback we received, we can work on improving the quality of our project for you and soon we'll be able to announce the official release!
Here's a juicy spoiler: there's a secret polyamorous route in the game that's sure to add some excitement. 👀

While you wait for the release, Let's get to know a bit more about the game's characters?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250998/9bd64b1b9fcaeae8371240e983e820da06394cb9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250998/350400bf7ce27dc11d560bf111452e08d95e3d88.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43250998/9b6686828100f2e9cc460fed87ac25dc724b24c7.png[/img]

Make sure to add [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2228340/Burning_Secrets__A_Bara_Visual_Novel/]Burning Secrets[/url] to your Steam wishlist so you can stay informed on all the latest news, and get ready for an unforgettable adventure!
